John Delury (@JohnDelury)

Xi's last foreign trip was over six months ago & the destination was... South Korea. Big win for the Peninsula.

As formality, the Xi-Kim summit likely linked to 65th anniversary of PRC-DPRK treaty... altho that wasn't signed [by Zhou Enlai & Kim Il Sung] until July 11.

A North Korean women's club soccer team visited the South for the 1st time this week, raising hopes for a powerful moment of inter-Korean sports diplomacy. 

But with inter-Korean relations at a low point, the North's message was clear: They're not interested.

posts.text:
Secretary of State Marco Rubio, a fierce China critic, was banned in 2020 from entering the country. 

Chinese officials, however, are using a different transliteration of Rubio’s name, perhaps to allow him to visit without lifting the ban.

posts.text:
After Rubio was named Sec of State, Chinese gov't changed the Chinese character for Ru/Lu in Rubio's name. It may have been a clever diplomatic tool that lets China to allow him in the country, since sanctions on Rubio are under the previous spelling.
